sources.description: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.

Afflict a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, Curses, and other Chaos damage over time Debuffs on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.
Raise a Totem that bombards enemies afflicted by Chaos damage over time Debuffs.
Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.
Create a fiery Orb that periodically releases fiery pulses. Enemies that are very close to the Orb are Ignited. Flameblast can target a Solar Orb to be centred on the Orb instead of your location.
Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channel for.

Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.

Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.

Create a wall of Fire in front of you, which Ignites everything within its area. Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to also add Lightning damage to the Projectiles.
Launch a large ball of Fire which explodes on impact. The explosion Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to launch a ring of smaller firebolts.

Fire an arrow that drops from above, creating a Lightning burst. The arrow remains in the ground, and any Chaining Lightning beams can Chain to it. When Chained to, the arrows charge up for a brief period before releasing another Lightning burst. The Lightning Arrow Skill reduces this delay, causing bursts to happen more quickly.
Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.

Aim skyward and fire energy missiles at lingering bolts or arrows created by other Lightning Attacks in front of you. The missiles explode if they land close to a lingering bolt or arrow, dealing more damage in a larger area but destroying that bolt or arrow in the process.
Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.
Load your Crossbow with flaming bolts that explode on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
Load your Crossbow with charged bolts that land around the target location and explode if hit by a Detonator Skill. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.

Fire a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.

Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.
Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.
Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.

Fire an arrow into the air that lands after a short delay, damaging enemies and causing a plant to spring up at the impact location. The plant sprouts vines that latch onto nearby enemies, Slowing their movement speed and dealing Chaos damage over time. The plant can be Poisoned, causing it to deal more damage.
Fire an icy arrow that sprays a cone of ice shards when it hits a target.

Channel to charge up your bow before releasing a powerful shot. Releasing with Perfect Timing causes the arrow to explode on impact and Consume Freeze on directly Hitting. Consuming Freeze enhances the explosion.
Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.

Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.
Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.

Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.

Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.
Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam.

Attack enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.

Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.

Raise a Totem that Slams the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. Jagged Ground erupts when hit by this Slam, damaging enemies standing on it. The Totem cannot create Jagged Ground. This Skill can be used while Shapeshifted.

Perform a damaging Warcry, Knocking Back nearby enemies and Heavy Stunning enemies that are Primed for Stun. If an enemy is Heavy Stunned or a currently Heavy Stunned enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers subsequent Slams to perform an additional Aftershock. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.
Mark a Corpse with a profane rune, dealing Chaos damage over time to nearby enemies. When the ritual is complete the Corpse is consumed and you gain a Power Charge.

Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.
Mark a target. The next Critical Hit the target receives Activates the Mark, Consuming it to deal extra damage and grant you a Frenzy Charge.
Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.

Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.
Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.

Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.

Perform a Warcry, Empowering subsequent Melee Attacks if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
Strike with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.

Slam the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with Fully Broken Armour applies Sundered Armour, making it take additional increased Physical damage.
Load your Crossbow with a clip of bolts that can be fired rapidly and Break enemy Armour. Using this Skill again reloads the clip.
Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that apply Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.
Load your Crossbow with icy bolts that create two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of their flight.

Load your Crossbow with Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of shrapnel. Bolts that hit an Ice Crystal cause it to explode. These fragments can Merge.

Fire an electrifying arrow that explodes in an Area on Hit. Hitting an enemy will attach an Electrocuting Rod to them, causing all incoming Lightning damage to build up Electrocution. This rod is removed when the enemy is next Electrocuted.

Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Electrocuted. When the Marked target is Electrocuted, the Mark Activates, granting a Buff which gives extra Lightning damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.
While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. Consumes the Parried Debuff on Hitting enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a Frenzy Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes Strikes and Projectiles to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting Bleeding on all enemies struck.
Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered Blood Loss will cause a blood explosion and also Consume Bleeding. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Mark a target, making them suffer Heavy Stun build up from Blood Loss. The Mark will Activate, Consuming itself to Trigger Blood Explosion, when they are Heavy Stunned, or when they are killed if they suffered enough Blood Loss. The Mark's duration does not expire while the Marked target is suffering Blood Loss.

Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.

Whip up a twister with a flick of your Spear. The twister moves forward erratically, Blinding and repeatedly Hitting enemies within. If a twister touches a Whirlwind from your other skills, it Consumes the Whirlwind to create additional twisters that deal more damage. Passing over Elemental Ground Surfaces or Consuming an elemental Whirlwind will grant twisters extra damage of that element.

Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts Bleeding and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, Maiming them for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.

Hurl a single payload Spear that pierces through enemies and lodges in terrain where it lands. The Spear will explode at the end of its Detonation Time or if Detonated. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if you have one to explode immediately, dealing more damage in a cross-shaped area and creating Ignited Ground.
Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.

Passively gains Seals over time. Using the skill fires a projectile, and breaks the Seals, Repeating for each of them, and for each additional projectile the skill is given. For each time it Repeats normally, it will also Repeat an additional time targeting a different Ice Fragment in its area of effect if able, Detonating those Ice Fragments immediately.

Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.

Shapeshift into a Werewolf and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first Attack can dash to faraway enemies and the final Attack Strikes twice. Attacking a Frozen enemy will create Ice Fragments, which are Projectiles that land and explode after a short delay.

Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be Hit separately by both gouges. Hitting a Marked enemy with both gouges will Activate the Mark and cause an additional shockwave. Ice Fragments will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode. immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.
Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.
Shapeshift into a Bear and Slam the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend Rage to create larger shockwaves that leave behind Jagged Ground.
Shapeshift into a Bear and charge forward, Slamming the ground as you run. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage.

Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a Power Charge. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a Slam.

Shapeshift into a Wyvern and spit Oil at enemies, creating Oil Ground where the Projectiles land. Consumes Power Charges if possible to instead Channel a sustained barrage of electrified Oil that does not create Oil Ground. Projectiles are fired in sequence, allowing multiple Projectiles to Hit the same target.

Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become Shocked or Frozen more easily. Plants in the area become Overgrown.

Uplift a volcano from the earth, damaging enemies standing on it and releasing a spray of molten Projectiles. While the volcano persists, Slamming it will cause another Projectile spray. Channelling this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent Projectile sprays.

Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.

Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.

While active, Fire Spells you use yourself will also summon Raging Spirits, which are short-lived flaming skulls that rush at nearby enemies and rapidly Attack them, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.
Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage
Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.

Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting. 
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from Hits. Taking a Hit that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that Minion's shield to absorb all damage from that Hit, then explode.  The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.
Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Warriors.
Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.

Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike, granting you a powerful Spell damage Buff as long as the spike remains. Does not affect your Minions. 
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.
Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.
Consume a Corpse or Power Charge to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from Power Charges are Empowered and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.

Dash to a target and Strike them with your Quarterstaff. If the target is Shocked, Consume their Shock to release a Lightning shockwave around the target and grant you a Power Charge. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.
Teleport to an enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.
Simultaneously fires a Physical Projectile and a Chaos Projectile at the target. These projectiles Chain through any number of Cursed targets.
Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.
Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.
Channel a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.
Plant a seed of Fire inside an enemy. Dealing enough damage to the enemy, or killing it outright, causes the seed to explode, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind a Fire Infusion Remnant.

Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.

Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals Physical damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an Elemental Ground Surface absorbs that surface's Debuff, applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.

Consume a Power Charge when you cast a damaging Spell to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same Spell for you. Does not work with Channelling Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, Triggered Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a Power Charge. This Skill is not directly Supportable.

Replaces your dodge roll with an explosive-assisted leap, firing off a round from your prosthetic cannon leg that Blinds and Ignites enemies in the area you escape from. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.
Fire a bouncing Grenade that explodes when its fuse expires, throwing out a ring of mini Grenades that explode when they come to a stop.

Conjure hateful energy to fuel your Rage and Life. While active, Bleeding enemies you kill have a chance to spawn a Hateful Remnant, and Hitting a Bleeding target spawns a Hateful Remnant every few seconds. Picking up a Hateful Remnant grants you Rage and recovers Life based on your current Rage.

Build Glory by gaining Rage while already at maximum Rage. When you have maximum Glory, roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you Gain Fire damage and Rage regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave Bear form, but will resume if you return to Bear form before the duration expires.

Mark a target, making them more susceptible to being Frozen. When the Marked target is Frozen, the Mark Activates, granting you a Buff which gives extra Cold damage and Consuming the Mark. Marking another target while you have the Buff will remove the Buff.
Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.

Dash to an enemy and run them through, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. If this Attack kills at least one enemy, it grants you a Frenzy Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.

Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and Trigger Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.

While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by Elemental Ailments or hit Rare or Unique enemies affected by Elemental Ailments. The swarms are untargetable Minions that pursue nearby enemies to Attack them and inflict Faerie Fire on Hit.

recipes.title: Spread Essence Drain through a pack
recipes.hook: Contagion spreads other Chaos damage-over-time debuffs when its affected enemy dies. Essence Drain supplies such a debuff.
recipes.mechanics: Contagion spreads other Chaos damage-over-time debuffs when its affected enemy dies. Essence Drain supplies such a debuff.
play: Apply Contagion to an enemy in a pack.
Hit the same enemy with Essence Drain, then kill it.
Check the nearby enemies for both debuffs.
conditions: A Contagion-affected enemy must die near other enemies.
This spreading mechanism needs deaths; an isolated boss does not supply a pack-clear chain.
avoid: Damage over time is not a recurring critical hit.

buildPlan.playstyle: Manual setup and payoff: Essence Drain → Contagion.
buildPlan.firstTest: Use one low-life enemy next to a durable enemy; compare spread with and without Contagion.
buildPlan.stopIf: The second enemy does not receive the debuff, or preparing every pack costs too much time.
nextChecks: Confirm the exact interaction with your current skill versions before investing in gear.
Measure repeatable damage, resource use and setup time against a durable target.
Check weapon requirements, sockets, defenses and target uptime before expanding the build.

recipes.title: Give Dark Effigy a target
recipes.hook: Dark Effigy targets enemies affected by Chaos damage-over-time debuffs; Essence Drain can provide the prerequisite.
recipes.mechanics: Dark Effigy targets enemies affected by Chaos damage-over-time debuffs; Essence Drain can provide the prerequisite.
play: Place Dark Effigy near the test target.
Apply Essence Drain and observe the totem attacking.
Reapply the debuff before it expires.
conditions: The enemy must have an active Chaos damage-over-time debuff and be within totem range.
Totem and player damage require separate scaling checks.
avoid: Do not infer that player cast speed or spell damage automatically scales every totem component.

buildPlan.playstyle: Manual setup and payoff: Essence Drain → Dark Effigy.
buildPlan.firstTest: Compare totem behavior on the same target before applying Essence Drain, during the debuff and after expiration.
buildPlan.stopIf: The totem cannot keep attacking between applications, or its contribution is too small.

recipes.title: Use a contaminated corpse to carry Contagion
recipes.hook: The Contagion source explicitly allows an affected corpse explosion to spread Contagion on hit.
recipes.mechanics: The Contagion source explicitly allows an affected corpse explosion to spread Contagion on hit.
play: Apply Contagion and kill the affected enemy.
Detonate its corpse beside a fresh enemy.
Check whether the explosion transfers Contagion.
conditions: The selected corpse must actually carry Contagion.
The corpse is consumed, so repeatability depends on corpse supply.
avoid: Do not assume any corpse in the area carries the debuff, or that isolated bosses supply corpses.

buildPlan.playstyle: Manual setup and payoff: Contagion → Detonate Dead.
buildPlan.firstTest: Keep one uninfected enemy near a Contagion-affected corpse and detonate only that corpse.
buildPlan.stopIf: The debuff does not transfer or corpse selection is unreliable.

recipes.title: Place Flameblast away from your character
recipes.hook: Solar Orb is explicitly targetable by Flameblast, moving the explosion centre to the Orb.
recipes.mechanics: Solar Orb is explicitly targetable by Flameblast, moving the explosion centre to the Orb.
play: Place Solar Orb near the target.
Aim Flameblast at the Orb and channel briefly.
Compare the explosion centre with a normal Flameblast.
conditions: Solar Orb must be available from your equipped item or skill setup; verify the current acquisition method.
Flameblast remains a channelled skill; the Orb does not automate casting or remove exposure while channeling.
avoid: Do not treat remote targeting as a zero-button build.

buildPlan.playstyle: Manual setup and payoff: Solar Orb → Flameblast.
buildPlan.firstTest: Place the Orb well away from yourself and check the actual centre of a short Flameblast.
buildPlan.stopIf: The Orb cannot be targeted with your version, or the channeling window is unsafe.

recipes.title: Use Ball Lightning as a teleport destination
recipes.hook: Lightning Warp explicitly accepts Ball Lightning projectiles as targets, providing a destination without waiting for an enemy to become cullable.
recipes.mechanics: Lightning Warp explicitly accepts Ball Lightning projectiles as targets, providing a destination without waiting for an enemy to become cullable.
play: Cast Ball Lightning toward the desired destination.
Target that projectile with Lightning Warp.
Check the teleport, projectile consumption and available resources.
conditions: The projectile must still exist and be targetable.
A projectile-target teleport does not promise all effects that require targeting an enemy.
avoid: Do not assume the enemy-only Shocked Ground effect also occurs when targeting a projectile.

buildPlan.playstyle: Manual setup and payoff: Ball Lightning → Lightning Warp.
buildPlan.firstTest: Warp to one isolated Ball Lightning projectile in open ground; repeat while moving.
buildPlan.stopIf: Target selection is unreliable or repeated casting cannot be sustained.

recipes.title: Add Fire damage along Fireball’s flight path
recipes.hook: Flame Wall adds Fire damage to projectiles that pass through it. Fireball offers a projectile to test the crossing requirement.
recipes.mechanics: Flame Wall adds Fire damage to projectiles that pass through it. Fireball offers a projectile to test the crossing requirement.
play: Place Flame Wall between yourself and a target.
Fire Fireball through it.
Compare with Fireball fired beside the wall.
conditions: The projectile must cross the actual wall.
Keep skill levels and other buffs fixed during the comparison.
avoid: Passing through Flame Wall does not automatically Ignite every target.

buildPlan.playstyle: Manual setup and payoff: Flame Wall → Fireball.
buildPlan.firstTest: Use the same target and compare shots through and beside a single wall; check the added-damage effect.
buildPlan.stopIf: Projectiles miss the wall or placing it costs more than the damage gain.

recipes.title: Make Lightning Arrow work through placed rods
recipes.hook: Lightning Rod accepts chaining Lightning beams. Its source specifically names Lightning Arrow as reducing the delay before another rod burst.
recipes.mechanics: Lightning Rod accepts chaining Lightning beams. Its source specifically names Lightning Arrow as reducing the delay before another rod burst.
play: Place a Lightning Rod near enemies.
Fire Lightning Arrow so its beams can chain to the rod.
Reposition the rod when enemies move.
conditions: Rod placement and chain range determine whether the interaction happens.
A bow is required; actual burst frequency needs observation.
avoid: Do not assume all beams hit every rod or multiply a single-target hit count by projectile count.

buildPlan.playstyle: Manual setup and payoff: Lightning Rod → Lightning Arrow.
buildPlan.firstTest: Place one rod beside a durable enemy and observe whether Lightning Arrow produces additional rod bursts.
buildPlan.stopIf: The beams do not reach the rod or repositioning dominates the rotation.

recipes.title: Spend lingering rods on Magnetic Salvo
recipes.hook: Magnetic Salvo aims at lingering bolts or arrows from Lightning attacks and destroys them when its empowered explosions land nearby.
recipes.mechanics: Magnetic Salvo aims at lingering bolts or arrows from Lightning attacks and destroys them when its empowered explosions land nearby.
play: Place Lightning Rod arrows in front of you.
Aim Magnetic Salvo at the rod area.
Rebuild the rods before repeating.
conditions: The rods must still exist when the missiles land.
This spends the objects that a rod-burst setup may want to keep.
avoid: Do not count the same rod as permanently available after a successful Salvo explosion.

buildPlan.playstyle: Manual setup and payoff: Lightning Rod → Magnetic Salvo.
buildPlan.firstTest: Place a small number of rods, fire one Salvo and verify rod consumption and explosion location.
buildPlan.stopIf: Rod replacement costs too much time or missiles miss the intended area.

recipes.title: Choose when grenades explode
recipes.hook: Explosive Shot’s explosion explicitly causes nearby grenades to explode, allowing a deliberate payoff before the natural fuse ends.
recipes.mechanics: Explosive Shot’s explosion explicitly causes nearby grenades to explode, allowing a deliberate payoff before the natural fuse ends.
play: Throw an Explosive Grenade beside the target.
Fire Explosive Shot so its explosion covers the grenade.
Reload and compare with waiting for the fuse.
conditions: Both skills require a compatible crossbow setup.
The explosion must overlap the grenade; include reload and setup time in any comparison.
avoid: Do not call earlier detonation a damage multiplier without measuring the full rotation.

recipes.title: Use a Bleeding target to create Rage remnants
recipes.hook: Rake inflicts Bleeding. Sanguine Revelry can create Hateful Remnants from hits on a Bleeding target at an interval, or from Bleeding enemy kills; collecting them grants Rage and Life recovery.
recipes.mechanics: Rake inflicts Bleeding. Sanguine Revelry can create Hateful Remnants from hits on a Bleeding target at an interval, or from Bleeding enemy kills; collecting them grants Rage and Life recovery.
play: Enable Sanguine Revelry and apply Rake.
Continue hitting the Bleeding target.
Collect an actual Hateful Remnant and check Rage and recovery.
conditions: The target must still be Bleeding.
Remnant generation has an interval; collection and existing Rage affect the payoff.
avoid: Do not assume every hit drops a Remnant or that an uncollected Remnant already restored resources.

recipes.title: Build Glory by gaining Rage at the cap
recipes.hook: Maul generates Rage on hit. Walking Calamity builds Glory from Rage gained while already at maximum Rage, then grants a temporary meteor effect.
recipes.mechanics: Maul generates Rage on hit. Walking Calamity builds Glory from Rage gained while already at maximum Rage, then grants a temporary meteor effect.
play: Use Maul to reach the actual Rage maximum.
Continue hitting while already at maximum and watch Glory.
Activate Walking Calamity when Glory is full.
conditions: Both skills need the Bear/talisman setup.
The meteor effect is suppressed outside Bear form; gaining Rage below the cap is not the described Glory condition.
avoid: Do not assume the first Rage gained immediately fills Glory or that every encounter begins with the payoff ready.

recipes.title: Use a Primed window to activate Freezing Mark
recipes.hook: Ice Shot can build Freeze. Wave of Frost immediately Freezes enemies Primed for Freeze, which can activate Freezing Mark’s extra Cold-damage buff.
recipes.mechanics: Ice Shot can build Freeze. Wave of Frost immediately Freezes enemies Primed for Freeze, which can activate Freezing Mark’s extra Cold-damage buff.
play: Mark a target and build Freeze with Ice Shot.
Wait for the Primed-for-Freeze state.
Hit it with Wave of Frost and observe the consumed Mark and buff.
conditions: This bow-plus-quarterstaff setup needs an explicit weapon swap; include its cost.
Wave of Frost does not promise instant Freeze before the enemy is Primed.
avoid: Do not reapply Freezing Mark during its buff, because marking again removes that buff.

recipes.mechanics: Ice-Tipped Arrows can empower eligible attacks to create Ice Fragments on hit. Use Ice Shot to place them, then Freezing Salvo to target and detonate nearby fragments with extra repeats.

recipes.hook: Azmerian Swarms can summon temporary minions when you hit a Rare or Unique enemy affected by an Elemental Ailment, or kill an ailment-affected enemy. Ice Shot supplies cold hits to test actual Chill or Freeze.
recipes.mechanics: Azmerian Swarms can summon temporary minions when you hit a Rare or Unique enemy affected by an Elemental Ailment, or kill an ailment-affected enemy. Ice Shot supplies cold hits to test actual Chill or Freeze.
